items.title: Fred Minor Interview, 1961-11-01
items.q: Harry Faggert, he was across the lake, though.

ctx.x: Yeah, Son, Duh, that's what they called him. Maybe I've heard of him. I haven't seen Danny for so long, you forget about him being from here. And then we had a fine banjo player with us, Harry Faggert.
Harry Faggert, he was across the lake, though.
